pretreatments.description: Solid-state alkaline pretreatment using NaOH solution (various concentrations such as 0.25, 0.625, 1.25, and 1.85 M) on corn stover in sealed zipper bags for 24 hours at ambient temperature.
Simultaneous alkaline treatment and digestion (SATD) - mixing NaOH solution, corn stover, and digest effluent immediately for digestion without pre-pretreatment delay.
